source: Ronda 22 (uso real r18 t2-c16, t3-c11, t4-c09 «…y guárdala en el escritorio»): the visible name of the known folder a capture was saved to (ProductCatalog capture.screenshot «folder»; pictures is its screenshots subfolder), told in the final with the file's name.

notKeptFloor.en: I did not save it to «{place}».

notKeptSource: Revisión r22 (bloqueante 1): a place the person asked the capture to be kept in that the operation cannot take (no known folder, or a known folder after the first) travels as notDone (action notKept, target the place as said) and the final says it was not saved there.
